[LTIM.14.1] **`calendar.time` and `calendar.date`.** The engine must build
each value below from its fields in the proleptic Gregorian calendar
([LTIM.1.2.4]):

| Call | Value |
|---|---|
| `calendar.time(year, month, day)` | the `Time` at midnight UTC of that day |
| `calendar.time(year, month, day, hour, minute, second)` | the `Time` at that wall-clock time in UTC |
| `calendar.time(year, month, day, hour, minute, second, nanosecond)` | the same instant plus `nanosecond` nanoseconds |
| `calendar.date(year, month, day)` | the `Date` of that day |

Every argument is an `Int`, and the arities are the three and one above
([LEXP.17.1]). A `Time` it builds is in UTC: its `tz_offset_ns` is 0
([LTIM.1.1.1]), and `.local(tz)` gives it a zone's offset ([LTIM.3.2.1]).
